name: manual_3583f3
claim: On Windows, treat memory-tool flock warnings as a real concurrency limitation because fcntl is unavailable; serialize memory writes and preserve append-only evidence.

decisions.notes: The renderer warned that lessons.jsonl concurrent-write protection was disabled on this Windows host, so the session used sequential canonical tool invocations.
